description: Delete the stored results of every done run finished at or before before_unix; each then reads done with result: null, purged: true. Frees state_bytes_max quota the results were counted against.

before_unix.description: Purge results of runs finished at or before this unix timestamp.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.runs.purge
